svg.title: Bar chart: linear term frequency against the BM25 tf part for f = 1 to 10

text.tspan: Linear counting never stops; BM25 saturates at k1 + 1
Blue numbers under the axis are the BM25 tf part; amber bar tops are the raw count f.
